Name: Show Players Behind Map Tiles
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17288]Transparent Tiles[/url] to make is so when a farmer is completely behind map tiles, it sets the tiles above and around the player to three separate levels of transparency:

[list=1]
[*]The two tiles covering the player ([b]﻿InnerTransparency[/b])
[*]﻿The tiles surrounding the player except for the corners ([b]OuterTransparency[/b])
[*]The four corners surrounding the player ([b]CornerTransparency[/b])

[/list]
The three transparencies are independent and configurable in the config.Transparency values should be a decimal between 0 and 1 (0 being invisible and 1 being opaque).

The player house and greenhouse are not a part of the map and do not work with this mod.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17288]Transparent Tiles[/url]﻿.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
